relationships.subject: Magi-1

relationships.subject: PY(A) lipidated peptide
relationships.evidence_quote: These data suggest that the sustained pain reduction provided by the PY(A) peptide attenuated arthritic subchondral bone erosion.

key_findings: Magi-1 knockdown in mice reduced MIA-induced osteoarthritis pain behavior.
A single intra-articular lipidated PY(A) peptide targeting the NaV1.8-Magi-1 interaction gave weeks of analgesia in rats and limited subchondral bone loss.
